title: Robots at Home
text:
In the future, many people will have robots at home. A robot can clean the floor, cook simple meals, and remind you about your appointments. Some robots can even talk to you in English.

Robots will also help doctors in hospitals. They can carry medicine from room to room. Many people think robots will make life easier, but some worry about losing jobs.

questions.text: What can a robot do at home, according to paragraph one?
Where can robots carry medicine, according to paragraph two?
options: From room to room in a hospital
From the city to the mountains

questions.text: Why might some people worry about robots?
options: They are too small to see

questions.text: What is the author's attitude toward robots?

vocabulary.definition: machines that can do tasks automatically
a substance used to treat illness

paragraph_translations: Gelecekte birçok insanın evinde robotları olacak. Bir robot yeri süpürebilir, basit yemekler pişirebilir ve randevularınızı hatırlatabilir. Bazı robotlar sizinle hatta İngilizce konuşabilir.

Robotlar hastanelerde doktorlara da yardım edecek. Odalar arasında ilaç taşıyabilirler. Birçok insan robotların hayatı daha kolay hale getireceğini düşünüyor, ama bazıları iş kaybetmekten endişe ediyor.
